Celebrity Traitors Finale Draws Record Audience Amid Fan Concerns

The finale of the television show Celebrity Traitors achieved a record average audience. Separately, fans expressed concern online after James Acaster appeared to be omitted from the show's companion program, "Uncloaked." In other related news, presenter Maya Jama was reportedly filming, and co-stars were seen at a Halloween party, fueling romance rumors.
